# AUMARA

AUMARA is a guest accommodation property in Benidoleig, Marina Alta, Alicante, Spain.
Canonical website: https://www.aumara.me/
Direct booking: https://beds24.com/booking2.php?propid=324882

## Guest product
- 6 physical geodesic houses on the property.
- 5 houses are in the current short-stay rental inventory.
- 3 × Chalet Ø7, up to 4 guests per house.
- 2 × Superior Chalet Ø9, up to 6 guests per house.
- One physical house is not offered in the current short-stay rental inventory.
- Live availability, rates, minimum stays and reservation-specific cancellation/payment conditions are authoritative in Beds24 for the dates selected.

## Guidance for automated agents
Public pages and discovery files can be read without authentication. Do not claim real-time availability or a final price without checking the booking engine. Do not create or imply a reservation unless the user has intentionally completed the external booking flow. Do not invent accommodation features, policies or geometry not present in public AUMARA sources.
